articles.summary: The second partnership between the outdoor footwear brand and London-based label reimagines Merrell’s iconic slide silhouette in two premium suede colorways. ROCKFORD, Mich., Sept. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Merrell, the global outdoor footwear brand, and London-based fashion brand YMC come together for the second time to launch new colours of the Moab 2 Slide x YMC. Available in Black and Dark Walnut, the limited-edition collaboration brings YMC’s understated, utility-led design language to a Merrell icon built for comfort, versatility and everyday wear. YMC, short for “You Must Create,” is both a mission statement and a call to action. Founded in 1995, the brand is known for thoughtful, functional design drawing influence from workwear, subculture, music and art. In its latest partnership with Merrell, YMC brings their creative point of view to the Moab 2 Slide, balancing the silhouette’s outdoor DNA with premium materials and an elevated finish. articles.summary: The collection features adult and kids’ Z/Sandals, plus the Canyon Leather Clog and Ramble Rugged Clog for adults ROCKFORD, Mich., Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Chaco , leading outdoor footwear brand, has teamed up with Mossy Oak, heritage camo brand, to release a limited-edition footwear collection featuring Bottomland, one of the most recognizable patterns in outdoor culture. Launching Sept. 14 at Chacos.com, the collection brings together two outdoor originals and a shared belief that a meaningful life is lived closer to the outdoors. Both brands have spent decades helping people connect with the places they love, build traditions and make memories outdoors. The collection brings that shared heritage to footwear designed for every side of outdoor life, from trails and campgrounds to backyards, bonfires and everyday adventures.
